test.result: PASS 4 Python tests; PASS 19 Rust tests; four compiled mutations rejected

verified_behavior: The fixture compiles and executes the complete production sender-drain helpers, PreparedBoot validation/close methods, IRQ callback and route lifecycle.
Sender closure and retirement precede node synchronization; BUSY nodes retire before irq_work_sync.
Successful synchronization precedes master removal and exactly one target-user decrement.
Sender and first/second BUSY-node timeouts keep admission closed and retain owners, master, generation and target-user count.
Concurrent callback/close cases keep late callbacks quiet and allow admitted callbacks to drain.
Negative compiled controls reject missing synchronization, premature sender retirement, the wrong BUSY bit and premature master removal.
limitations: Linux synchronization, allocation and master behavior are mocked; no module linkage or kernel execution is proven.
PreparedBoot::close_irq_senders has no production caller and booted shutdown remains ENOSYS.
DRAINED route slots remain unavailable for reuse.
No shutdown runtime or formal acceptance credit is granted.
